analysis: Use fixed independent native-Hz frequencies from the frozen F2 model, without new component identity or source detection. Joint Hann-weighted cosine/sine/DC least squares in200ms windows every20ms; L-derived coefficient magnitudes are a statistical proxy. Solve one fixed full-rank design, preserving all13 modes. Same gain applies to both channels of each OSC; all carrier frequencies/phases and residual streams unchanged. No LFO, recorded envelope sequence, PCM, room, artificial stereo width or source-ID branch.
